fact: Law 001-2021/AN, adopted 30 March 2021, requires under art. 19 that where processing relies on AI the criteria and nature of the data be disclosed at collection, and under art. 31 puts decision-support processing resting on predictive AI techniques under prior authorisation of the CIL.
title: Loi n°001-2021/AN portant protection des personnes à l'égard du traitement des données à caractère personnel
publisher: Assemblée nationale du Burkina Faso (published by the Commission de l'informatique et des libertés)
